title: Breaking Up with Normatively Monolithic Agency with GRACE: A Reason-Based Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Safe and Ethical AI Alignment
reasoning: The paper proposes the GRACE architecture, which is specifically designed for ethical and safe AI alignment. It features a 'Moral Module' that uses symbolic reasoning grounded in normative reasons to determine the permissibility of actions. The work focuses on moral reasoning, deontic logic, and ethics in AI agents, including a specific case study of an LLM-based therapist navigating ethical dilemmas.
